correctness.rationale: Exact degree-block singular analysis yields RR* diagonal h_n(u)/N_n, and Dirichlet–multinomial coupling proves monotonicity and the target norm. Pole-order coefficient asymptotics give each exponential or polynomial branch and the sharp Schatten threshold. The same uniform coupling yields a signed finite-N Jensen defect bounded by explicit Dirichlet variance; uniform conditional Laplace expansion proves the 1/N coefficient and O(N^-2) remainder. Edge cases (all zero, all one, equal t, repeated radii) are covered. A packaged Python checker passed 7,936 exact/numerical finite diagnostics; finite tests are not the infinite proof.

The sharp log divergence constant at the critical exponent, and a nontrivial 1/N window converting an undamped noncompact restriction into compact spectral decay, provide motivated quantitative invariants.
